notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that can prevent the user from switching melee weapons.
[*]Improved camera tracking to reduce the chances of motion sickness.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a bug that can prevent the user from switching melee weapons.

tags.feature: [*]Improved camera tracking to reduce the chances of motion sickness.

notes.title: Savegame Protection Update
notes.content: Fixed a rare issue where the sequence CONTINUE->QUIT->START->QUIT->CONTINUE will reset the savegame's difficulty mode and collected placards.

tags.bug: Fixed a rare issue where the sequence CONTINUE->QUIT->START->QUIT->CONTINUE will reset the savegame's difficulty mode and collected placards.

notes.title: Crosshair Animation Fix
notes.content: Fixed the crosshair animation not resetting when a lock-on is cancelled manually.

tags.bug: Fixed the crosshair animation not resetting when a lock-on is cancelled manually.

notes.title: UI and Game Balance Updates
notes.content:
New features:

[list]
[*] Weapon selection wheel
[*] Objective cues
[*] More achievements
[*] In-game strategy guide
[*] Spanish localization
[*] Beginner-friendly gameplay tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: French Localization
notes.content: Added French to the language selection.

tags.feature: Added French to the language selection.

notes.title: Remembrance Day Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added region detection that automatically chooses one of the supported languages at startup.
[*] Improved UI scaling to keep text and images fully inside non-16:9 displays.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added region detection that automatically chooses one of the supported languages at startup.
[*] Improved UI scaling to keep text and images fully inside non-16:9 displays.

notes.title: Feature Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] An easy mode that gives the player greater combat abilities and endless time in exchange for 25% less scoring.
[*] Steam Cloud saving.
[*] Steam Cloud leaderboard.
[/list]

tags.feature: An easy mode that gives the player greater combat abilities and endless time in exchange for 25% less scoring.

notes.title: NPC AI Update
notes.content: Addressed a few unusual situations where an NPC may get stuck during heavy battles.

tags.bug: Addressed a few unusual situations where an NPC may get stuck during heavy battles.

notes.title: More Achievements and Player-Friendly Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Extra achievements can be earned by reaching different milestones.
[*] The game now reminds you when you wander off-course into dangerous territories. 
[/list]

tags.feature: Extra achievements can be earned by reaching different milestones.
The game now reminds you when you wander off-course into dangerous territories.

notes.title: Easier Menu Navigation on a Keyboard
notes.content:
Players can now navigate the game menus on a keyboard in different ways:

1. ASDW + Space Bar
2. Arrows + Enter
3. Numeric Arrows + Numeric Enter
